title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Reshef of Destruction
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 4710 (addresses converted to GBA bus addresses)

widgets.text:
Life Points 8000; Deck Capacity (DC) limits the deck
Win duels to raise DC

Guardian Stars give +500 when your star beats theirs
Fusion by playing two monsters together (fusion combinations)
Choose the guardian star that beats the defender's
Travel around the world to stop Reshef; areas unlock through the story
Cards won from duels; deck editor within DC

Hundreds of cards to collect
Trunk quantities are tracked per card (e.g. Winged Dragon of Ra)

Story chapters; final duel with Reshef
Domino and deck capacity grow from duels
